translate_en|mods/TrueSmoking/42.13/medi: Automatically put out the smoke when finished
Shows Debug information on the moodle tooltips
Enable or disable the feature to find and light a smoke automatically
Hide all action bars related to smoking
Hide the action bar that appears during puffing
Automatically puff when the smoke is about to go out
Take a puff or relight a cigarette, find a cigarette if not smoking
Set the maximum time interval for passive puffing
Set the minimum time interval for passive puffing
Enable automatic passive puffing while holding a cigarette
Show the number of days remaining until recovery from addiction
Show the remianing percentage of the smoke
Display text above the players head for withdrawal symptoms
You have a nicotine addiction, you need ~%1 to recover.
You could go for a smoke.
You are desperate for a smoke.
Smoke is currently %1, there is %2 left
Chance (%) to cough per puff if player does NOT have the Smoker trait
Chance (%) to cough per puff if player has the Smoker trait
Enable chance to cough when taking a puff
How many in-game days of heavy smoking until player gains the Smoker trait
How many in-game days without smoking until player loses the Smoker trait
How many in-game days it takes to reach peak withdrawal symptoms after quitting
Enable debug logging and debug UI panel (for mod developers and troubleshooting)
Drop chance (%) if player does NOT have the Smoker trait (much clumsier!)
Drop chance (%) if player has the Smoker trait
Chance to drop your lit cigarette when falling, climbing, or hit by zombies
Players can gain or lose the Smoker trait based on smoking habits
Multiplies all effects from smoking (nicotine, stress relief, boredom relief, etc.)\n50 = half effects · 100 = normal · 200 = double effects
How much smoking reduces fatigue\n0 = no fatigue reduction · 0.25 = subtle (default) · 1.0 = vanilla strength · 2.0 = double
How much smoking reduces hunger\n0 = no hunger reduction · 0.25 = subtle (default) · 1.0 = vanilla strength · 2.0 = double
How quickly the cigarette goes out when standing still\n0 = never goes out (always stays lit)\n100 = goes out normally (needs relighting)
Automatically lowers shemaghs, gas masks, etc. when smoking and re-equips them after
How much faster the smoke burns when walking, running or sprinting\n25 = barely burns while moving · 100 = normal · 200 = burns fast when active
Forces every cigarette, cigar, pipe, etc. to use the value below
How strong each puff feels (nicotine hit + stress/boredom relief)\n50 = weak puffs · 100 = normal · 200 = very strong
Base length of all smokables when Override is enabled or item has no custom length\nHigher = lasts longer
If the ember gets too weak, you can relight it instead of it dying completely
How quickly addiction and withdrawal decrease when player has the Smoker trait\nHigher = faster decay
Global burn speed for ALL smokables\n25 = lasts forever · 100 = balanced · 200 = burns very fast
Enables the new smoking moodle which better reflects nicotine levels and withdrawal
Turns on nicotine tracking, withdrawal effects, and dynamic addiction
